page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 2 physical cores, 1 thread per core, and 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or a GPU, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average performance for single-core tasks but lower efficiency for multi-core and memory-intensive workloads. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1880.19, and the Geekbench single-core score is 1310.0, both falling into the average category. However, multi-core performance is limited, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 1926.99 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 1547.0, both rated as poor. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, showing 7.6 GB/sec for large-block read-only operations and 6.13 GB/sec for large-block write operations.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.g7.large is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and single-threaded applications. It achieves a static web serving throughput of 2.69 GB/sec and a Redis SET operations rate of 1.99 million operations per second. The instance is not recommended for memory-bound databases, heavy multi-threaded processing, or large-scale LLM inference, though it can handle small-scale text generation tasks with a 135M model at 63.13 tokens per second.
